extraction.agency_name: Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services
extraction.parent_department: Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services

findings.title: An Agreement with a State’s Attorney Office Did Not Include Sufficient Specifications
findings.description: DPDS agreement excluded critical elements like specific deliverables and payment terms; payments totaled $794,100 in FY2007 without verification of actual costs.

dollar_amounts.context: FY 2007 payments to State's Attorney Office
FY 2006 payments to State's Attorney Office
annual appropriation approved for payments

findings.recommendation: Modify SAO agreement to include payment terms and deliverables; ensure payments consistent with revised agreement.
findings.agency_completion_date: Agreement by 1 July 2008, verification process by 1 September 2008 or first payment under new agreement.

findings.title: Service Agreements Were Not Adequately Monitored to Ensure Payments Were Made in Accordance with Related Terms and That All Requirements Were Met
findings.description: DPDS did not adequately monitor service agreements; oversight of off-site housing payments insufficient, contractor maintenance costs not verified, temporary employee contract management inadequate (higher cost vendors used).

dollar_amounts.context: off-site housing contract total
base payments in off-site housing contract
per diem payments in off-site housing contract
test of three invoices for per diem housing charges
two invoices for per diem housing charges lacking signatures
contractor annual maintenance costs required to provide
DPDS paid maintenance costs over contractor amount in FY2007
contractor's payments to outside vendor for maintenance function
FY 2006 temporary personnel expenditures
FY 2007 temporary personnel expenditures

findings.recommendation: Adequately monitor service agreements; ensure requirements met and invoices approved by supervisory personnel; improve management of temporary employee contract to use lower cost vendors.
findings.agency_completion_date: Payment approval process modified since 1 April 2008; temporary employee placement form process implemented.

findings.title: Proper Internal Control Was Not Established Over the Processing of Certain Disbursement Transactions
findings.description: DPDS did not fully use FMIS security features allowing unauthorized transactions; five employees could initiate and approve without independent review ($10 million); payments made without verifying receipt of goods/services.

dollar_amounts.context: disbursements processed via FMIS in FY2007
disbursement transactions initiated and approved by same employee in FY2007
test of seven payments made during FYs 2005-2007
five payments lacking documentation to support receipt of goods/services
ammunition paid without receiving report

findings.recommendation: Fully use FMIS security features; establish independent online approval requirements; ensure documentation supporting receipt is received prior to processing invoices.
findings.agency_completion_date: FMIS security authorizations corrected on 19 July 2007; formal accountability established for documentation.

findings.title: Adequate Control Over Certain Corporate Purchasing Card Transactions Had Not Been Established
findings.description: Inadequate control over CPC transactions; equipment purchased could not be located ($3,883); purchases split to circumvent limits ($10,082); documentation inadequate for 24 charges.

dollar_amounts.context: items purchased with corporate purchasing cards tested
value of 50 items tested
items valued at that amount could not be located on premises
CPC purchases split into smaller purchases to circumvent limits
transactions where invoices did not provide sufficient detail or costs not detailed
fiscal year 2007 CPC activity total

findings.recommendation: Comply with Comptroller's Manual; record and account for equipment items; do not split transactions; maintain documentation.
findings.agency_completion_date: CPC authorization process changed to ensure Property Officer receives requisition form; monthly statements reviewed; formal accountability established.

findings.title: Supervisory Review of Supporting Documentation for Payroll Adjustments Was Not Documented
findings.description: Supervisory employees did not document review of payroll adjustment documentation (time sheets, overtime forms); errors/unauthorized adjustments could be processed without detection.

dollar_amounts.context: DPDS payroll expenditures in FY2007
employee overtime in FY2007

findings.recommendation: Supervisory personnel document verification of payroll adjustments to source documents.
findings.agency_completion_date: Procedures changed in July 2007; additional steps taken for management verification.

findings.title: Adequate Documentation of Year End Entries Was Not Maintained and Certain Entries Effectively Allowed Funds Provided by Fiscal Year 2006 Accruals to be Used to Fund Fiscal Year 2007 Expenditures
findings.description: DPDS did not maintain proper documentation for FY2006 accrued expenditures ($2.9 million); journal entries allowed use of prior year accruals for current year; $126,390 improper accrual (invoice previously paid).

dollar_amounts.context: FY 2006 general fund accrued expenditures
test of six FY 2006 accrued expenditures
accruals with inadequate support or improper documentation
improper accrual related to unpaid invoice previously paid

findings.recommendation: Comply with Accounting Procedures Manual; maintain proper documentation; discontinue practice of using prior year accruals for current expenditures; revert unliquidated accruals and $126,390 to General Fund.
findings.agency_completion_date: Will comply with Manual and maintain documentation; will submit listing of accrued expenditures; agrees to revert $126,390 during FY 2008 closing.

findings.title: Property Records Were Not Adequately Maintained, and DPDS Did Not Reconcile Its Physical Inventory with Its Related Detail Records
findings.description: Property records not maintained per DGS requirements; physical inventory not reconciled with detail records (e.g., washers/dryers discrepancy); control account not maintained.

dollar_amounts.context: reported book value of DPDS equipment as of June 30, 2007
cost of 32 equipment items purchased during FYs 2006-2007 tested

findings.recommendation: Comply with DGS Inventory Control Manual requirements.
findings.agency_completion_date: Physical inventory reconciled; control accounts confirmed; detail records maintained in new databases; annual physical inventory by 30 June 2008.

findings.title: Procedures and Controls Over the Materials and Supplies Inventory Were Inadequate
findings.description: Procedures inadequate for materials/supplies inventory; differences between perpetual records and physical inventories not investigated ($28,000 difference in uniforms); value not reported to DGS.

dollar_amounts.context: DPDS spent for materials and supplies during FY 2006
value of materials and supplies at central storeroom as of June 30, 2007
total value of uniforms according to inventory records
value according to physical inventory counts for uniforms
difference between uniform record and physical inventory values

findings.recommendation: Comply with DGS Inventory Control Manual; investigate differences; review adjustments by supervisory personnel; report balances to DGS.
findings.agency_completion_date: Differences investigated/resolved; adjustments reviewed/approved; records converted to electronic spreadsheets; additional records established by 30 May 2008.

findings.title: DPDS Had Not Executed a Lease with an Entity That Had Been Using DPDS Facilities, and Certain Rent Payments Had Not Been Requested
findings.description: No new lease executed with nonprofit entity occupying space; no rent requests since Dec 2005; outstanding receivable balance $27,606.

dollar_amounts.context: outstanding receivable balance related to billings from April-Dec 2005
monthly rent amount entity previously paid

findings.recommendation: Determine lease amounts owed and follow-up to collect; ensure future uses supported by BPW approved lease.
findings.agency_completion_date: Working with Assistant Attorney General to determine amounts owed; review completed by 15 May 2008.

findings.title: Certain Fraudulent Acts Discovered by DPDS Were Not Immediately Reported to Authorities
findings.description: Lack of documentation that fraudulent acts were immediately reported to Attorney General - Criminal Division; three employees presented fraudulent medical docs, one failed to report time worked; referrals received in Oct 2007 (late).

dollar_amounts.context: monetary loss to the State for two of these cases

findings.recommendation: Promptly inform appropriate authorities of instances of possible criminal or unethical conduct.

extraction.agency_response_summary: DPDS agreed with most recommendations and noted steps taken prior to report issuance. They disagreed in part with Finding 6 regarding the consistency of their accrual adjustment practices but agreed to revert specific funds ($126,390).
extraction.extraction_notes: Finding 10 response not included in provided text snippet. Criminal referral confirmed for Finding 10 based on 'referral letters were received' statement.
